mapper.sql: a.id, a.title, a.content, a.class_id, a.course_id, a.creator_id, a.activity_type, a.activity_date, a.attachment, a.attachment_name, a.status, a.create_time, a.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT , ci.class_name, co.course_name, u.real_name as creator_name FROM class_activity a LEFT JOIN class_info ci ON a.class_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN course co ON a.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.creator_id = u.id WHERE a.id = #{id}

SELECT , ci.class_name, co.course_name, u.real_name as creator_name FROM class_activity a LEFT JOIN class_info ci ON a.class_id = ci.id LEFT JOIN course co ON a.course_id = co.id LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON a.creator_id = u.id WHERE a.status = 1 ORDER BY a.activity_date DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_activity (title, content, class_id, course_id, creator_id, activity_type, activity_date, attachment, attachment_name, status, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{title}, #{content}, #{classId}, #{courseId}, #{creatorId}, #{activityType}, #{activityDate}, #{attachment}, #{attachmentName}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW())
